title: Engineering a Paraburkholderia pallida Tannase for Improved Catalytic Efficiency, Thermal Stability, and Green Tea Clarification.
authors: Gao, Fuquan; He, Keman; Lin, Tingting; Sun, Haorong; Hu, Xiaoyu; Chen, Yaoyu; Li, Qiyu; You, Xinyu; Wang, Xiaxia; Chen, Si; Yu, Xiaomin
journal: Journal of agricultural and food chemistry
one_liner_zh: 该文通过计算热点预测和分子动力学模拟对单宁酶进行工程改造，提升催化效率和热稳定性，虽以酶为对象，但结构建模与MD方法可迁移至蛋白质结构计算研究。
abstract: Tannases can reduce haze and astringency in tea beverages, but their application is often limited by poor thermal stability and catalytic efficiency. A tannase from Paraburkholderia pallida (Tanpp) was engineered using active-site mutagenesis and computational hotspot prediction. The double mutant F384T/N307A showed the best performance, with a 2.7-fold increase in catalytic efficiency and an 11-fold longer half-life at 50  degrees C than wild-type Tanpp. Structural modeling and molecular dynamics simulations suggested that N307A widened the substrate-entry region, whereas F384T compacted the catalytic pocket. The double mutant remained more stable at 323.15 K. In green tea clarification assays, F384T/N307A produced the lowest turbidity and promoted conversion of galloylated catechins into non-galloylated products and gallic acid. It retained superior performance across the tested enzyme dosages and treatment times. These findings show that coordinated active-site remodeling can improve both catalytic performance and thermal durability, supporting F384T/N307A as a promising tannase for tea clarification.
abstract_zh: 单宁酶可减少茶饮料中的浑浊和涩味，但其应用常受限于较差的热稳定性和催化效率。通过活性位点突变和计算热点预测，对来自Paraburkholderia pallida的单宁酶（Tanpp）进行了工程改造。双突变体F384T/N307A表现出最佳性能，其催化效率较野生型Tanpp提高了2.7倍，在50°C下的半衰期延长了11倍。结构建模和分子动力学模拟表明，N307A拓宽了底物进入区域，而F384T使催化口袋更加紧凑。双突变体在323.15 K下仍保持更高的稳定性。在绿茶澄清实验中，F384T/N307A产生了最低的浊度，并促进了没食子酰化儿茶素转化为非没食子酰化产物和没食子酸。在测试的酶剂量和处理时间范围内，它均保持了优越的性能。这些发现表明，协调的活性位点重塑可同时提高催化性能和热耐久性，支持F384T/N307A作为茶澄清应用中具有前景的单宁酶。
